limits: The fixed byte is substituted at every write to 0x9695 from zero-based frame 145 onward. These are deliberately altered manual CPU runs, NOT reference-emulator parity results. With fixed zero the control paths avoid damage too; with fixed 255 fire avoids damage while no-fire/A do not. T also changes actor animation/execution timing and can affect enemy updates even when RNG is held fixed. None of these observations identifies a general sword hitbox, enemy kill or collision formula.
